records.contract: xxh64(data: *const u8, n: usize, seed: u64) -> u64
records.semantics: public XXH64 one-shot: four seeded lanes, 32-byte stripes (round rol(acc + k*P2, 31) * P1), mergeRounds, 8/4/1-byte tails, 64-bit avalanche

the merge multiplies the stripe loop pre-multiply lane value by P1*P2 mod 2**64 before rol-31/*P1, because pre * P1 * P2 == v * P2; this computes round(0, v) without recomputing v * P2
je at 0x61dae3c jumps to the avalanche when data is null; h = seed + P5 + n with no buffer load, so a null pointer yields the seeded empty-input avalanche even for nonzero n

h = rol(v1,1) + rol(v2,7) + rol(v3,12) + rol(v4,18), then one mergeRound per lane (h ^= round(0, v); h = h*P1 + P4); the + n term is folded into the last mergeRound as + P4 + n (add %rbp,%r8 at 0x61daf8d); the short path (n < 32) instead starts from h = seed + P5 + n
the type-3 arm of rocksdb::ComputeBuiltinChecksum (0x616bca0) calls 0x61dae20 here and keeps the low 32 bits (reconstructed in PR #5413)
